source_dependency.reuse: Public synthetic exogenous draw generator; no protected source first-use

objective: Falsify CKAD22's seed-concentrated new-candidate gain using two entirely new synthetic structural equations, eight disjoint evaluation draw namespaces, and three already-qualified independently retained native parent checkpoints. Each native model must acquire evidence through actual action-consequence interventions, not from hidden source family labels.

worlds.name: interaction_gate
worlds.transition: s2=(x1 AND s1) XOR 1 XOR transition_noise

public_interface: Two public views [(s1,nuisance_a),(s1,nuisance_b)]. Chosen a1 -> actual s2 -> chosen a2 -> actual y. hidden, transition_noise, reward_noise, true name/regime and alternate outcomes never passed to learner.
case_schedule: 3 parent checkpoints * 8 independent synthetic draw namespaces * 2 new world structures = 48 trained transfer cases; no claim that eight namespaces are eight independently trained model seeds.
training: Begin each test case from SHA256-verified complete CKAD22 parent checkpoint. For each of 16 new source episodes, native novel_active selects both sequential interventions from public views and observed s2; retrieval_only/pooled/Beta receive exactly those same receipts and identical actions. Novel_random has identical probe budget but its own predefined hash-seeded random first and second actions on the same exogenous probe episodes. Freeze per-world control budgets, identity, and source readout. The trained frozen old prefix is never mutated or overwritten.
scoring: For each case score 48 independent held episodes for each trained policy by actually applying its choices, same exogenous draw across arms; no held updates. Independently evaluate 48 familiar invariant/regime0 held episodes on that same trained checkpoint after new-family learning. Report means, per-parent-group, per-namespace-seed, per-family, exact exact-control parity and action divergence.
controls: full_beta and trailing_mle fully fit from all 448 CKAD22 parent public action receipts plus 16 observed active probe receipts, using the same capacity/settings as prior CKAD22 qualified ConventionalControl. retrieval_only, pooled_replay trained on identical receipts and actions. Novel_random samples separate public action interventions but no extra budget. Exact independent mixture is required to tie all novel policies and forecasts.

frozen_go_thresholds.family_wise_novel_vs_retrieval: At least +3 percentage points (>=35 additional successes out of 1152 held cases per new family) compared to retrieval_only, both new families.
frozen_go_thresholds.family_wise_novel_vs_beta: At least as many successes as full_beta in both new families.
frozen_go_thresholds.seed_namespace_robustness: At least 6 of 8 composite-source namespaces show positive pooled novel_active minus retrieval_only on both new world structures. This is environmental replication only, not independent fully trained baselines.
frozen_go_thresholds.retention: Familiar invariant/regime0 after new training: novel_active >=75% and at least retrieval_only minus5 percentage points for each world.
frozen_go_thresholds.first_use: True protected-first-use count = 0, user-visible provenance distinguishes newly authored unprotected synthetic development fixtures from reserved scientific test data.

negatives: Source generator exact SHA and native checkpoint exact SHA match
No hidden bits passed to readouts
No source intervention before a public action is chosen
No held sample learning; all 16 public probe event IDs unique
No state/ledger prefix mutation, cold restore bytes preserved
Independent exact online-mixture predictions and plans match native
Retain all failed thresholds and 3 group controls; do not post-tune
scope: Isolated parallel development branch; no accepted main edit, no merge/new PR, no production or autonomous controller changes. Fully synthetic source additions have separate provenance from previously consumed worlds.
